recipe.notes:
The owner's T4 judge (the identity, outage and text-four-phases scenarios). Client block from the scenarios: no temperature is sent, max_output_tokens 16384, context_tokens 131072 (the scenario's engine --max-model-len; the checkpoint's own mpe is 262 144 -- open question 5 keeps the scenario value because it matches the client budget), decoding json_schema, image_processor qwen3_vl, max_images 10. The scenarios' per-slot concurrency (64) is runtime tuning; the recipe carries the catalog's 256 (open question 4). Serving: --reasoning-parser qwen3, --max-model-len 131072, TP1, limit_mm_per_prompt {"image": 10}. Memory arithmetic, both GPU classes (GiB, --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 default). Weights 30.9 GB (24.7 GB FP8 + 6.2 GB BF16 at the pin). - B200 (192 GB; 0.92 -> 176.6 GB budget): TP1 -> 30.9 GB weights, ~146 GB cache. KV (BF16): 16
  full-attention layers x 2 x 4 KV heads x 256 x 2 B = 65 536 B/token -> a full-length 131 072-token sequence
  ~8 GiB (~18 sequences); after 64 concurrent sequences' linear-attention state (48 layers x 48 value heads x
  128 x 128 x 4 B ~151 MB each, ~9.7 GB) still ~17 full-length sequences, or ~750 typical 2k-token
  tournament windows. resources.gpus: 1; throughput scales by replicas.
- H100 (80 GB; 0.92 -> 73.6 GB budget): TP1 fits (30.9 GB weights, ~43 GB cache): ~5 full-length sequences,
  ~250 typical 2k-token windows after the 64-sequence linear state. Same shape -- no `--set` override.
History: the paper never ran this checkpoint (it is the owner's T4 judge); the paper's TREC-DL judge is the separate qwen3.6-27b family. Engine support: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration is in vLLM v0.31.0's registry (registry.py:596); checked at the pinned revision 2026-10-09. status: unverified until the E2 judge wave passes.

The scenario pin, equal to the Hub head at the check date. The served name is the recipe id; the T4 scenarios override it to their slot name at run time. B200 and H100: TP1 (resources.gpus 1).
